beam_activation (CONFIRMED - RE MILESTON.rule: TnPickupFactory.SetPickupVisible -> PickupEffect.ActivateSystem(); SetPickupHidden -> PickupEffect.DeactivateSystem(). InitializePickup calls SetPickupVisible at begin play, so an attached Pickup_FX beam is ON whenever the factory is available, OFF while taken/Sleeping.
beam_activation (CONFIRMED - RE MILESTON.ammo crates (14): beam on while available, every mode; off when taken; on again after RespawnTime 30 s
beam_activation (CONFIRMED - RE MILESTON.flag factories (2): CTF only (otherwise Disabled: actor hidden, no collision). Each round only the defending-team factory is in Pickup (beam on); the other Sleeps (beam off). Taken -> Sleeping (RespawnTime 9999999); returned -> Pickup immediately
beam_activation (CONFIRMED - RE MILESTON.bomb factory (1): EXT only (otherwise Disabled). Taken -> Sleeping; returned after a score after WaitAfterScoreTime 5.0 s, other returns immediately
beam_activation (CONFIRMED - RE MILESTON.health / overshield Pickup_FX (10): never drawn: not in the Components array, never attached
beam_activation (CONFIRMED - RE MILESTON.ShouldDisplayHighlightFx: True on TnAmmoCratePickupFactory and on TnWeaponPickupFactory (inherited by flag/bomb); the controlling authored value

implementation_guidance: health/overshield: CustomPickupEffect visible while the pickup is available; hide on pickup; show again after RespawnTime (CONFIRMED by the same SetPickupVisible/Hidden path)
ammo crate: static mesh PROP_NEU_AmmoPickup_STAT (rotating Yaw 10000/65536 turn/s) plus the Pickup_FX highlight beam, both shown while available
health/overshield Pickup_FX components: do not render (not attached)
